Paramount moves closer to Warner Bros takeover after settling state, union lawsuitsParamount settled with a coalition of US states and the Writers Guild of America over its proposed acquisition of Warner Bros Discovery. ONGC strikes gas in Mahanadi deep waters off Odisha coastONGC's latest gas discovery could be developed with nearby deposits using shared infrastructure, but its reserves and commercial viability are yet to be established.

Bitcoin crosses $85,000. 3 key reasons fuelling the crypto rallyBitcoin is back in the spotlight after crossing $85,000. The rally has also spread to altcoins and meme coins, with several popular tokens posting strong gains.

Tata Sons row: Mehli Mistry objects to trust funds paying legal costsMehli Mistry, a trustee of Tata Education and Development Trust (TEDT), raised the objection in an email to Siddhartha Sharma, CEO of Tata Trusts. The communication was also copied to Tata Trusts Chairman Noel Tata and fellow TEDT trustee JN Mistry.

India-New Zealand FTA from October 20: Duty-free access, $20 billion investmentThe agreement will give all Indian goods duty-free access to New Zealand. It will also make it easier for students and workers to move between the two countries.

Sensex, Nifty ends higher; crude falls as markets recover from six-week slideThe Sensex closed 564.03 points, or 0.76%, higher at 74,858.99, while the Nifty 50 rose 67.90 points, or 0.29%, to 23,414.30. The Sensex opened at 74,535.18, while the Nifty opened at 23,330.20.

3 BHKs are the new favourite for Indian homebuyers. Here's why3 BHKs are fast becoming the new favourite among Indian homebuyers. But what is making buyers choose bigger homes even as property prices keep rising?

Sensex, Nifty jump: 3 reasons why stock market is rising despite West Asia tensionsAt 2:11 pm, the Sensex was up 649.50 points, or 0.87%, at 74,944.46, while the Nifty rose 109.20 points, or 0.47%, to 23,455.60. Both indices were trading above their opening levels of 74,535.18 and 23,330.20, respectively.

entertainment.headline: President Murmu urges film stars not to endorse health-harming products At the 72nd National Film Awards, President Droupadi Murmu urged film stars not to endorse products harmful to health.

Govinda seeks blessings at Lalbaugcha Raja with co-star Rani Swarnkar Actor Govinda visited Lalbaugcha Raja with co-star Rani Swarnkar and performed the final aarti. The appearance has drawn fresh attention as it comes amid Ssunita Ahuja's cheating allegations.

Staying together can lose curiosity: Abhishek Banerjee on long-term relationships Actor Abhishek Banerjee said communication and personal space are both vital in long-term relationships. He said constant togetherness can erode curiosity, while honest conversations help avoid misunderstandings.

Dream of small town boy: Kartik Aaryan celebrates National Award with a moving note Actor Kartik Aaryan celebrated his Best Actor National Award for Chandu Champion with an emotional note about his journey from Gwalior. I find it uneducated: Parineeti Chopra backs Katrina Kaif amid postpartum trolling Actor Parineeti Chopra supported Katrina Kaif after online comments targeted her postpartum appearance. She said physical changes after childbirth should be celebrated, not criticised.

SRK, Alia, KJo pay last respects to Rani Mukerji's mother Krishna Shah Rukh Khan, Alia Bhatt, and Karan Johar were among those present in Mumbai for the funeral of Rani Mukerji's mother, Krishna Mukerji, who died on Tuesday at the age of 75.

Look above political interest: Centre breaks silence on National Film Awards row Ashwini Vaishnaw defended holding the National Film Awards in Gujarat and said the ceremony would move to tourist destinations across India.

Karnataka my karmbhoomi, Bharat my dharmbhoomi: Anant Nag in Dadasaheb Phalke speech Anant Nag received the Dadasaheb Phalke Award at the 72nd National Film Awards, marking another milestone in his five-decade career. The veteran actor dedicated the honour to his collaborators and the millions who embraced his characters.

Veteran actor Anant Nag receives Dadasaheb Phalke Award to standing ovation President Droupadi Murmu presented Anant Nag with the Dadasaheb Phalke Award at the 72nd National Film Awards in Ekta Nagar. The honour recognises a screen career of more than five decades spanning parallel cinema, mainstream films and television.

Aditya Dhar collects Best Feature Film National Award for Article 370 in Gujarat Article 370 won Best Feature Film at the 72nd National Film Awards in Ekta Nagar. The film also picked up acting and music honours, underlining its strong showing at the ceremony.

Malayalam star Mammootty receives his 4th Best Actor National Award, calls it magic Actor Mammootty received his fourth National Film Award for Best Actor for Bramayugam at the 72nd National Film Awards. The win, shared with Kartik Aaryan, also capped a strong showing for the black-and-white film.

President Murmu presents Best Director Award to Rajkumar Periasamy for Amaran Director Rajkumar Periasamy received the National Film Award for Best Direction for Amaran from President Droupadi Murmu in Ekta Nagar. The honour highlighted his direction of the biographical drama, which juxtaposes Major Mukund Varadarajan's personal life and military career.

Kartik Aaryan dedicates first National Award to parents, calls them his 'world' President Droupadi Murmu conferred Kartik Aaryan with his maiden National Film Award for Chandu Champion at Ekta Nagar. The landmark honour signals a major dramatic pivot for the actor while bringing Paralympic legend Murlikant Petkar's long-overlooked journey into the national spotlight.

President Murmu confers Best Actress National Award on Yami Gautam for Article 370 President Droupadi Murmu conferred Yami Gautam with her maiden National Film Award for Best Actress for her lead performance as intelligence officer Zooni Haksar in Article 370 at Ekta Nagar. The landmark honour — for which she stood as the sole recipient — anchored a major double victory as the political thriller was also crowned Best Feature Film.

I don't do any magic, something comes my way: Mammootty on National Film Award Mammootty has won his fourth National Award for Best Actor for his performance in Bramayugam. Manoj Tiwari's daughter Rhiti trolled over Rs 25K allowance, vada pav 'struggle' On Bigg Boss 20, Rhiti Tiwari described her limited allowance and strained equation with her father Manoj Tiwari. Her remarks about hardship quickly drew sharp reactions online and revived the nepotism debate.

sports.headline: Which Lakshya Sen turned up in Japan?
